answer: A proposed haven exchange rejects keys without a biometric-deduplicated personhood credential; each extra earning alias costs a new person 20 minutes of live attendance. At the meadow bridge, witnesses run synchronized liveness checks, compare registry entries, and bind one active credential per person to one key, rejecting duplicates and reuse. 10 aliases need 10 people and 200 person-minutes. Independent witness cross-checks curb issuer fraud; colluding witnesses, biometric errors and rented humans remain risks.
